parsed_output.reasoning_summary: This arm is a pure placebo: respondents read the exact necktie filler that also appears in the control condition (control is a random mix of three off-topic fillers). There is therefore no persuasive mechanism whatsoever, and the only possible source of a nonzero ATE is (a) sampling noise and (b) any trivial differential effect of the necktie text relative to the average of the baseball and dance fillers — all three are equally off-topic, non-emotional, and unrelated to science or climate. Accordingly I forecast ATEs statistically indistinguishable from zero on all 13 outcomes, with magnitudes set to plausible realized-noise levels (roughly 0.05–0.15 points on 0–100 scales given SDs of ~20–28 and n of ~500 vs ~1,000, which implies standard errors near 1.1–1.4 points; my point forecast is well inside that band rather than exactly 0). For the incentivized outcomes I use a couple of cents on the donation and a fraction of a percentage point on newsletter sign-up. Signs are assigned essentially arbitrarily and are not meaningful; I keep distrust marginally positive and trust marginally mixed so as not to imply any coherent treatment pattern.
